title: Boat Rentals
specs: Closest boat rental facility to Shell Island with direct access to St. Andrews Bay
Paddleboards designed for beginners and casual paddlers
Beach wheelchairs require leaving a license/ID during usage
No pets allowed on the ferry
Shell Island Ferry offers 20% discount for groups of 20 or more paying together

blurb: Guests can rent pontoons, kayaks, paddleboards, bicycles, golf carts, umbrellas, chairs, and wagons. Pontoon rentals include safety equipment, fuel, maps, and training. Visitors can also rent pavilions for private events and take a ferry to Shell Island with no time limit on the stay.
extraNote: No time limit on stay at Shell Island but must catch last ferry off the island · Beach wheelchairs are free to use with license/ID left during use · St. Andrews State Park, Panama City Beach, Florida
